ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMEREMAIL_SEC
AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail AS 
(
SELECT
    ISNULL(BST.CLTCODE,BSTD.CLTCODE) AS CustomerId 
    ,'Primary' AS EmailTypeId 
    ,BST.PRIM_EMAIL AS EmailAddress 
    ,ISNULL(BST.DATE_CREATED,XY.DATE_OPEN) AS PeriodStartTimestamp 
    ,BST.LASTUPDATED AS PeriodEndTimestamp 
    ,NULL AS PreferenceId 
    ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote 
    ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator 
    ,CONVERT(DATE,NULL) AS DateOfRequest
    ,'SEC' AS SourceCode
    ,BST.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,BST.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
    ,RECORD_STATUS
FROM  BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSTD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BST
    ON BSTD.CLTCODE = BST.CLTCODE-- AND BSTD.STATUS = BST.STATUS
    AND BST.isLatest = 1
LEFT JOIN  (SELECT Y.CLTCODE ,X.DATE_OPEN
            FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS X LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK Y
                ON X.ACCTCODE = Y.ACCTKEY AND X.isLatest = 1 AND Y.isLatest = 1
            WHERE Y.CLTCODE IS NOT NULL) XY
    ON XY.CLTCODE = BSTD.CLTCODE
	
UNION

SELECT
    ISNULL(BST.CLTCODE,BSTD.CLTCODE) AS CustomerId 
    ,'Alternate' AS EmailTypeId 
    ,BST.ALT_EMAIL AS EmailAddress 
    ,ISNULL(BST.DATE_CREATED,XY.DATE_OPEN) AS PeriodStartTimestamp 
    ,BST.LASTUPDATED AS PeriodEndTimestamp 
    ,NULL AS PreferenceId 
    ,NULL AS CustomerEmailNote 
    ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator 
    ,CONVERT(DATE,NULL) AS DateOfRequest
    ,'SEC' AS SourceCode
    ,BST.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,BST.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
    ,RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSTD
LEFT JOIN  BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BST
    ON BSTD.CLTCODE = BST.CLTCODE --AND BSTD.STATUS = BST.STATUS
    AND BST.isLatest = 1
LEFT JOIN  (SELECT Y.CLTCODE ,X.DATE_OPEN
            FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS X LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK Y
                ON X.ACCTCODE = Y.ACCTKEY AND X.isLatest = 1 AND Y.isLatest = 1
            WHERE Y.CLTCODE IS NOT NULL) XY
    ON XY.CLTCODE = BSTD.CLTCODE
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH 
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_SRC AS
(
	SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerId ,EmailTypeId ,EmailAddress ,PeriodStartTimestamp ,PeriodEndTimestamp ,PreferenceId ,CustomerEmailNote ,DoNotDisturbIndicator ,DateOfRequest)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS, EmailTypeId,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(PeriodStartTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCECODE
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_TGT AS
(
	SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerId ,EmailTypeId ,EmailAddress ,PeriodStartTimestamp ,PeriodEndTimestamp ,PreferenceId ,CustomerEmailNote ,DoNotDisturbIndicator ,DateOfRequest)) HASHROW, CustomerId, 
    EmailTypeId,
    --convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(PeriodStartTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp,
    PeriodStartTimestamp,
     FinancialInstitutionId,
     SOURCECODE 
    FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail WHERE SourceCode = 'SEC' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01'
),
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA AS
(
	SELECT 
        SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
        ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.EmailTypeId,TGT.EmailTypeId) AS EmailTypeId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartTimeStamp,TGT.PeriodStartTimeStamp) AS PeriodStartTimeStamp
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SOURCECODE,TGT.SOURCECODE) AS SOURCECODE
        ,CASE WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE' ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_SRC SRC
    FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_TGT TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId
AND SRC.PeriodStartTimeStamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimeStamp
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA;

--------UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET	PeriodEndTimestamp = CONVERT(DATE,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp)
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId AND DELTA.PeriodStartTimeStamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimeStamp AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail SRC
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId AND SRC.PeriodStartTimeStamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimeStamp AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL

--------INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerEmail
(CustomerId 
,EmailTypeId 
,EmailAddress 
,PeriodStartTimestamp 
,PeriodEndTimestamp 
,PreferenceId 
,CustomerEmailNote 
,DoNotDisturbIndicator 
,DateOfRequest
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT
	SRC.CustomerId
	,SRC.EmailTypeId 
	,SRC.EmailAddress 
	,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp,'1900-01-01')
	,CONVERT(DATE,SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp ) 
	,SRC.PreferenceId 
	,SRC.CustomerEmailNote 
	,SRC.DoNotDisturbIndicator 
	,SRC.DateOfRequest
	,SRC.SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,SRC.WorkFlowId
	,SRC.TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA DELTA	 ON  DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.EmailTypeId = SRC.EmailTypeId AND convert(varchar,DELTA.PeriodStartTimeStamp) = convert(varchar,SRC.PeriodStartTimeStamp) AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = SRC.SOURCECODE  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'

---------INSERT NEW RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerEmail
(CustomerId 
,EmailTypeId 
,EmailAddress 
,PeriodStartTimestamp 
,PeriodEndTimestamp 
,PreferenceId 
,CustomerEmailNote 
,DoNotDisturbIndicator 
,DateOfRequest
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT
	SRC.CustomerId
	,SRC.EmailTypeId 
	,SRC.EmailAddress 
	,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
	,SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp
	,SRC.PreferenceId 
	,SRC.CustomerEmailNote 
	,SRC.DoNotDisturbIndicator 
	,SRC.DateOfRequest
	,SRC.SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail SRC
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmail_DELTA;

END
